kaikki_vikisozluk.e: نَحْنُ • (naḥnu) m pl or f pl
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Inherited from Proto-Semitic *niḥnu. Cognate with Hebrew אנחנו.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نحن (form I)
# نَحِنُّ (naḥinnu) /na.ħin.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of حَنَّ (ḥanna)
# نُحَنُّ (nuḥannu) /nu.ħan.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of حَنَّ (ḥanna)
# نَحِنَّ (naḥinna) /na.ħin.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَنَّ (ḥanna)
# نُحَنَّ (nuḥanna) /nu.ħan.na/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive/juss
